full_judgment: 4. Before parting however we must observe that the learned Judge is wrong in his view, that if there is a judgment of reversal and the two courts below had taken two different views, them the revisional court can go into facts to see whether the same was correctly decided by the appellate court, it is not sustained by any judicial authority, nor can we support such a proposition of law. The finding of fact, whether, concurrent or not, arrived at by the lower appellate court is binding on the High Court, both as second appellate court and a revisional court, except in certain well defined exceptional circumstances. With this observation the petition is dismissed.
